cohort: 1097 women who attended the community midwife team at the National Maternity Hospital Dublin, Ireland, during 2016 and 2017
finding: Low-risk women who attended midwifery-led services had a low caesarean section rate.
mod_finding: This study analyzed cesarean section rates using Robson's Ten Group Classification System for women attending midwifery-led care, finding a low rate in low-risk nulliparous women.
